en.Условие. Каково центростремительное уско: Problem. What is the centripetal acceleration of Venus in its orbital motion around the Sun (treat the orbit as circular)?
en.Идея. Нужны справочные данные: радиус ор: Idea. Reference data are needed: orbit radius R = 1.082·10¹¹ m and period T = 224.7 days (not in the statement). Acceleration a = ω²R = 4π²R/T².
en.Условие. Лифт движется вверх и вниз с ус: Problem. An elevator moves up and down with accelerations of equal magnitude. A student stands on a spring scale. The difference between the scale readings when moving up and down is 50 N. Find the acceleration (in an inertial frame).
en.Идея. В инерциальной системе: при ускоре: Idea. In an inertial frame: accelerating upward N₁ = m(g + a), accelerating downward N₂ = m(g − a). The difference N₁ − N₂ = 2ma. Important: the student's mass is not given, so we get a formula; the answer depends on m.
en.Для m = 50 кг: a = 25/50 = 0,5 м/с²; для: For m = 50 kg: a = 25/50 = 0.5 m/s²; for m = 60 kg: a ≈ 0.42 m/s²; for m = 70 kg: a ≈ 0.36 m/s².
en.a = 25 Н / m (спроси у преподавателя мас: a = 25 N / m (ask the instructor for the mass or plug in your own)
en.Если бы масса была дана, ответ — одна по: If the mass were given, the answer would be a single substitution. The magnitude of the elevator's acceleration does not depend on where it is going: the difference in readings is determined only by the value of a.
en.Условие. Пассажир массой 80 кг в машине,: Problem. An 80 kg passenger in a car travelling at 100 km/h is wearing a seat belt. The driver brakes hard and the car stops after travelling 45 m. What force did the belt exert on the passenger (without finding the acceleration)?
en.Идея. Не находить ускорение — значит исп: Idea. Not finding the acceleration means using the work–kinetic energy theorem: the work done by the belt force over the distance s equals the change in kinetic energy. The force is taken as constant.
en.F ≈ 686 Н (≈ 0,87 от веса пассажира): F ≈ 686 N (≈ 0.87 of the passenger's weight)
en.Ведро с водой в вертикальной плоскости: Bucket of water in a vertical plane
en.Условие. С какой наименьшей угловой скор: Problem. What is the smallest angular velocity at which a bucket of water must be swung in a vertical plane so that the water does not spill? The distance from the water surface to the axis of rotation is r = 80 cm.
en.Идея. Опасная точка — верхняя. В ней вод: Idea. The critical point is the top. The water does not spill there if the force of gravity is no greater than the required centripetal force. Critical case: the weight alone provides the centripetal acceleration, and the pressure force on the bottom is zero.
en.Машина на дуге аэродромной плиты: Car on an arc of an airfield slab
en.Условие. Автомобиль едет по бетонной пли: Problem. A car drives on a concrete slab along an arc of radius R = 100 m. The coefficient of static friction between the tyres and the concrete is f = 0.4. What is the maximum speed at which the car can drive without skidding?
en.Идея. Центростремительную силу создаёт с: Idea. The centripetal force is provided by static friction. Maximum friction: Tmax = f·N = f·mg (horizontal slab, N = mg).
en.Капля масла на лопатке турбины: Oil drop on a turbine blade
en.Условие. Найти частоту вращения паровой: Problem. Find the rotation frequency of a steam turbine if the centripetal force acting on an oil drop on a blade at a distance R = 1 m from the axis is n = 1000 times the weight of the drop.
en.Идея. Центростремительная сила F = mω²R: Idea. Centripetal force F = mω²R = n·mg. The mass of the drop cancels.
en.Условие. Шарик m = 50 г на нити длиной l: Problem. A ball m = 50 g on a string of length l = 0.5 m moves uniformly in a circle in a horizontal plane. The angle of the string from the vertical is α = 10°. Neglect the mass of the string. a) Where does the centripetal force come from? Find: b) the centripetal force; c) the acceleration; d) the tension in the string; e) the radius of the circle; f) the linear and angular velocity; g) the period and frequency.
en.Идея. На шарик действуют две силы: тяжес: Idea. Two forces act on the ball: gravity mg (down) and the string tension T (along the string). The ball does not move vertically: T cos α = mg. The horizontal component of the tension T sin α points toward the centre of the circle — this is the centripetal force.
en.a) Откуда сила: a) Where the force comes from
en.Равнодействующая тяжести и натяжения гор: The resultant of gravity and tension is horizontal and directed toward the centre of the circle. There is no separate “centripetal force”: it is the result of two real forces.
en.Fc = mg tg α = 0,05 · 9,81 · tg 10° = 0,: F<sub>c</sub> = mg tan α = 0.05 · 9.81 · tan 10° = 0.086 N.
en.Работа при подъёме груза с ускорением: Work when lifting a load with acceleration
en.Условие. Какую работу надо совершить, чт: Problem. What work must be done to lift a load of weight P = 0.3 kN to a height h = 100 m with an acceleration a = 3 m/s²? Solve in two ways: from the definition of work and from the change in mechanical energy.
en.Идея. Тело поднимают с ускорением вверх,: Idea. The body is lifted with an upward acceleration, the initial velocity is zero. Mass: m = P/g. Lifting force: F − mg = ma.
en.Условие. Тарзан m = 80 кг переместился с: Problem. Tarzan, m = 80 kg, moved from a tree (point A) to the ground (point B) using a vine of length l = 10 m attached at point C. Initially the vine makes an angle α = 45° with the vertical. a) Find the height h of the tree; b) the speed at which Tarzan reaches the ground, neglecting resistance.
en.Идея. Лиана закреплена на вертикали над: Idea. The vine is attached on the vertical above point B, so at the lowest point of the arc the vine is vertical. The height of A above B: h = l − l cos α. After that, mechanical energy is conserved.
en.Человек в лодке тянет верёвку: A person in a boat pulls a rope
en.Условие. Человек массой m₁ в лодке массо: Problem. A person of mass m₁ in a boat of mass m₂ pulls a rope with a constant force F. The other end of the rope is tied: a) to a tree standing on the shore; b) to a boat of mass m₃ that can float freely. Find the work done by the person during time Δt in both cases. Neglect resistance.
en.Идея. Работа силы F равна F·s, где s — п: Idea. The work of force F equals F·s, where s is the displacement of the point of application of the force along the direction of the force. The motions are uniformly accelerated from rest: s = aΔt²/2. The person and the first boat move as one body of total mass m₁ + m₂.
en.Движется только лодка с человеком: a = F: Only the boat with the person moves: a = F/(m₁+m₂), s = FΔt²/(2(m₁+m₂)).
en.Лодки сближаются: ускорения a₁ = F/(m₁+m: The boats approach each other: accelerations a₁ = F/(m₁+m₂) and a₃ = F/m₃, distances s₁ = a₁Δt²/2, s₃ = a₃Δt²/2. The rope, taut under force F, moves by both s₁ and s₃. The total work equals F(s₁ + s₃) and equals the total kinetic energy of both boats.
en.В случае b) работа больше, потому что см: In case b) the work is greater because both points of the rope move. The person's work goes into the kinetic energy of two boats.
en.Условие. Под каким наибольшим углом к го: Problem. At what maximum angle to the horizontal can an electric locomotive of power P = 1500 kW climb while pulling a train of weight F = 20 000 kN at a speed v = 7.2 km/h?
en.Идея. Подъём с постоянной скоростью: вся: Idea. Climbing at constant speed: all the power goes into increasing potential energy (friction is not given, so we neglect it). The vertical climbing speed is v sin α.
en.Условие. На горизонтальном пути транспор: Problem. On a horizontal track a vehicle of mass 400 kg travelled s = 100 m, accelerating from v₁ = 36 km/h to v₂ = 72 km/h while overcoming a resistance force T = 100 N. Find the engine power.
en.Идея. Находим силу тяги из ускорения, за: Idea. Find the traction force from the acceleration, then the average power as work over time or as force times average speed. Speeds: v₁ = 10 m/s, v₂ = 20 m/s.
en.Время t = (v₂ − v₁)/a = 6,67 с; W = F·s: Time t = (v₂ − v₁)/a = 6.67 s; W = F·s = 70000 J; P<sub>avg</sub> = W/t = F · 15 m/s.
en.В начале P = F·v₁ = 7,0 кВт, в конце P =: At the start P = F·v₁ = 7.0 kW, at the end P = F·v₂ = 14.0 kW: the power increases.
en.Условие. Доказать, что мощность двигател: Problem. Prove that the engine power in uniformly accelerated motion is not constant but is a linear function of time.
en.Идея. Мощность P = F·v. При равноускорен: Idea. Power P = F·v. In uniformly accelerated motion the acceleration a is constant, the traction force F = ma + T is constant (the resistance T is constant or zero), and the velocity grows linearly: v = v₀ + at.
en.F — константа, v(t) = v₀ + at — линейная: F is a constant, v(t) = v₀ + at is a linear function. The product of a constant and a linear function is a linear function of time: P(t) = F v₀ + F a · t.
en.P(t) = Fv₀ + Fa·t — прямая на графике P(: P(t) = Fv₀ + Fa·t — a straight line on the P(t) graph
en.Если разгон идёт из состояния покоя (v₀: If the acceleration starts from rest (v₀ = 0), then P = F·a·t — direct proportionality: the power grows from zero. The average power is half of the maximum.
en.Условие. Свободное падение камня весом Q: Problem. The free fall of a stone of weight Q = 20 N lasted t = 1.43 s. Find the kinetic and potential energy of the stone relative to the ground at the midpoint of its path.
en.Идея. Высота падения H = gt²/2. Середина: Idea. The fall height H = gt²/2. The midpoint of the path is at a height H/2 above the ground. The total mechanical energy is constant: E = QH. At the midpoint, the potential and kinetic energies are each half of the total.
en.H = 9,81 · 2,045/2 = 10,03 м; середина п: H = 9.81 · 2.045/2 = 10.03 m; the midpoint is at a height of 5.02 m.
en.При t/2 камень пролетел H/4: Ek = QH/4 =: At t/2 the stone has fallen H/4: E<sub>k</sub> = QH/4 = 50.2 J, E<sub>p</sub> = 3QH/4 = 150.5 J. But the “midpoint of the path” means the midpoint in height.
en.Условие. Столб длиной l = 8 м весом Q =: Problem. A pole of length l = 8 m and weight Q = 1500 N lies on the ground. A crossarm with insulators of mass m = 30 kg is attached to its upper end. What work must be done to raise the pole to a vertical position?
en.Идея. Работа равна приращению потенциаль: Idea. The work equals the increase in potential energy. The centre of mass of a uniform pole rises by l/2, and the crossarm at the upper end rises by l.
en.Условие. Вывести формулу скорости тела A: Problem. Derive the formula for the speed of body A sliding without friction along a circular arc of radius R as a function of the instantaneous angle φ (per the figure: the body starts from the edge at the level of the centre O, φ is the angle between the radius to the body and the horizontal).
en.Идея. Нормальная сила работы не совершае: Idea. The normal force does no work and there is no friction, so mechanical energy is conserved. The body starts from rest at the level of the centre; at angle φ it is below the centre by R sin φ.
en.Убыль потенциальной энергии mg·R sin φ п: The decrease in potential energy mg·R sin φ turns into kinetic energy mv²/2. The mass cancels.
en.При φ = 0 (старт): v = 0. В самой нижней: At φ = 0 (start): v = 0. At the lowest point φ = 90°: v = √(2gR), as in free fall from a height R.
en.Условие. Хоккеист массой 90 кг ударяет п: Problem. A hockey player of mass 90 kg hits a puck of mass 0.15 kg, giving it a speed of 45 m/s. Both are initially at rest on perfectly smooth ice. How far will the player slide back due to recoil during the time the puck takes to reach the goal 15 m from the point of impact?
en.Идея. Закон сохранения импульса для сист: Idea. Conservation of momentum for the “player + puck” system: the total momentum remains zero. Speeds are measured relative to the ice.
en.Упругий удар бильярдного шара о борт: Elastic bounce of a billiard ball off the cushion
en.Условие. Шар m = 200 г упруго отскакивае: Problem. A ball m = 200 g bounces elastically off the cushion, hitting it at an angle α = 25° (the angle is measured between the velocity and the normal to the cushion, as in the figure). The ball's speed is 10 m/s. a) Draw the momentum change vector and calculate its magnitude; b) for a collision duration of 0.1 s, find the average force acting on the ball (magnitude, direction, sign) and the force with which the ball acts on the cushion.
en.Идея. Удар упругий и борт гладкий: соста: Idea. The collision is elastic and the cushion is smooth: the velocity component along the cushion does not change, while the normal component v cos α reverses sign. The speed stays 10 m/s.
en.Δp = 2 · 0,2 · 10 · cos 25° = 4 · 0,9063: Δp = 2 · 0.2 · 10 · cos 25° = 4 · 0.9063. The vector Δp is directed along the normal, away from the cushion (perpendicular to the cushion).
en.F = Δp/Δt = 3,625/0,1; направлена перпен: F = Δp/Δt = 3.625/0.1; directed perpendicular to the cushion, away from the cushion (in the direction of the rebound).
en.По третьему закону Ньютона сила шара на: By Newton's third law, the force of the ball on the cushion has the same magnitude and the opposite direction: perpendicular to the cushion, toward the cushion.
en.Условие. На рисунке — восемь пар шаров р: Problem. The figure shows eight pairs of balls of different masses (the larger is heavier) that are about to collide centrally and perfectly inelastically. The arrows are velocities before impact (a longer arrow means a higher speed). a) In which case can the balls move to the left after the collision? Justify. b) Check in which direction they move if the masses are 80 g and 20 g, the lower speed in each case is 10 cm/s and the higher one is 50 cm/s. c) Calculate in each case the projection vx of the balls' velocity after the collision (x axis to the right). d) What must the mass of the larger ball be so that in one of the cases the balls stop?
en.Идея. Абсолютно неупругий удар — шары сл: Idea. A perfectly inelastic collision — the balls stick together. Conservation of momentum along the x axis: m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = (m₁ + m₂)V. Right is plus, left is minus. Reading from the figure: in pairs 1–4 both balls are moving; in 5–8 one ball is at rest. Long arrow = 50 cm/s, short = 10 cm/s.
en.a) Куда можно влево: a) Where leftward motion is possible
en.Влево может уехать только пара, у которо: Only a pair whose total momentum is negative can move to the left: we need a ball moving left with the larger momentum. That is only case 4: the heavy ball slowly to the right, the light one fast to the left. In all other cases the total momentum points to the right.
en.p = 80 · 10 − 20 · 50 = 800 − 1000 = −20: p = 80 · 10 − 20 · 50 = 800 − 1000 = −200 g·cm/s < 0, so after the collision the balls move together to the left.
en.Остановка возможна только при нулевом су: Stopping is possible only when the total momentum is zero — this is case 4: M · 10 = 20 · 50 ⇒ M = 100 g (instead of 80 g).
